name: TIS 166-2549 (Type O, Thai plug)
description: Thai household plug and socket system: two round 4.8 mm pins 19 mm apart, with a round earth pin 11.89 mm above their line on the earthed plug. Line and neutral pins are partly insulated. The standard also defines a two-pole plug for class II appliances on the same pin spacing.

standards.title: Plugs and socket-outlets for household and similar purposes: plugs and socket-outlets with rated voltage not exceeding 250 V
standards.scope: Thai plug and socket-outlet configurations (figures 1 to 3), rated up to 250 V and 16 A; renumbered from TIS 166-2547, whose text the published scan carries
General requirements referenced by TIS 166 (clauses 2 to 6)

variants.name: Two-pole plug with earthing pin (class I)
variants.keying: The earth pin above the line pins enforces polarity; L, N and the earth symbol are marked on the engagement face.
mechanicalNotes: Pins 4.8 mm in diameter; line and neutral 19 mm apart and 19 mm long, insulated for 10 mm from the face.
Earth pin 21.4 mm long, 11.89 mm from the line of the line and neutral pins.
Seen on the pin side with the earth pin up, neutral is on the left and line on the right (figure 1).

visuals.title: TIS 166 earthed plug (male), mating face, earth pin up
visuals.author: OpenPlugDB contributors

variants.name: Two-pole plug (class II)
mechanicalNotes: Pins 4.8 mm in diameter, 19 mm long, 19 mm apart, insulated for 10 mm.
Non-rewirable version has an elongated hexagonal face 35.5 × 14.6 mm (figure 2).

variants.name: Two-pole socket-outlet with earthing contact
variants.keying: Earth hole above the line and neutral holes; L, N and the earth symbol are marked on the face.
mechanicalNotes: Holes 5.3 mm in diameter; line and neutral 19 mm apart; earth hole 11.89 mm above their line (figure 3).
Looking into the socket-outlet with the earth hole up, line is on the left and neutral on the right (figure 3).
Nothing may protrude within a 39 mm diameter around the contacts, apart from the markings; protection against single-pole insertion is required (cover or shutter).

electricalProfiles.name: AC single-phase, earthed
conditions: Table 1 rates the socket-outlet and rewirable plugs 250 V, 16 A; non-rewirable plugs may be rated 2.5, 6, 10 or 16 A.

electricalProfiles.name: AC single-phase, class II (no earth)
conditions: Table 1 rates rewirable two-pole plugs 250 V, 16 A; non-rewirable plugs may be rated 2.5, 6, 10 or 16 A.
Not polarised: P1 and P2 are interchangeable.

notes: Values come from a scan of the standard published by Public.Resource.Org; its pages carry the TIS 166-2547 header, renumbered TIS 166-2549 in 2006.
Frequency is not stated in the reviewed clauses.
The universal dual socket-outlet of figure 4, which also takes Type A, B and C plugs, is not modelled; those cross-family matings wait for the corresponding family ids.
The earth pin spacing (11.89 mm) equals that of NEMA 5-15; a NEMA 5-15 plug mating with the Thai socket-outlet is not recorded.
